answer: Require every agent to post a 60 POA bond into a bridge escrow linking its task history to the ledger, released only after 30 days of verified work. Auditors randomly re-check 10% of tasks weekly; a failed check burns the bond and voids pending rewards. A zephyr of small, unpredictable spot checks stops fakes timing fraud, and a canyon between reputation and payout forces each new identity to repeat full probation from zero trust. Every extra fake locks another 60 POA for a month and faces a fresh audit lottery, so locked capital grows with each identity while expected forfeiture compounds.
